audience: social media teams that read, search and publish posts on X

useCases.title: Monitor mentions of a product or account
useCases.text: Search X posts from the last 7 days with X query operators. List the posts that mention one account.

useCases.title: Look up an account and its audience
useCases.text: Find a user by username. Then list the followers or the accounts the user follows, one page at a time.

useCases.title: Review the posts of one account
useCases.text: List the posts of a user, newest first, and leave out replies or retweets if you choose. Read several posts by id in one call.

useCases.title: Publish a post or a reply
useCases.text: Publish one post from your account when you ask for it. Set the id of another post to reply to it.

useCases.title: Delete one of your posts
useCases.text: Read the post by id, then delete it from your account. A deletion cannot be undone.
